description: Tribal Resilience Action Database is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Upper Snake River Tribes Foundation; Upper Columbia United Tribes; Columbia River Inter-Tribal Fish Commission. Explore a database of real actions developed by Tribes to build climate resilience. Project partners and advisors representing more than a dozen Tribes across North America worked to create this culturally sensitive, easily accessible database of climate adaptation strategies and community examples that have been published by Tribes. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Coastal, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
